meta_description: Cadby Plastering in Birmingham offers expert internal and external plastering for homes and commercial projects. Fast turnaround, competitive rates. Call today.
hero_subhead: From small patch repairs to full house replastering, Cadby delivers smooth, durable finishes on time and on budget.
services_subhead: Whether you need interior walls finished, external renders refreshed, or specialist coatings applied, we handle every type of plastering job.

services.title: Internal Plastering & Finishing
services.desc: Skimming, patching, and full wall replastering for living spaces, kitchens, and bathrooms. We leave surfaces smooth, ready to decorate.

services.title: External Render & Harling
services.desc: Weather-resistant external renders and decorative finishes that protect your home and enhance curb appeal for years to come.

services.title: Artex Removal & Replacement
services.desc: Safe removal of dated textured finishes and replacement with modern, clean plaster surfaces you'll actually want to look at.

services.title: Coving & Cornicing
services.desc: Bespoke coving installation and traditional cornicing work to add period character or a contemporary finish to your rooms.

services.title: Damp Remediation Plastering
services.desc: Specialist plasters and tanking systems applied to damp-affected walls to prevent moisture and restore interior surfaces.

services.title: Commercial & New Build Works
services.desc: Large-scale plastering for new developments, renovations, and commercial properties, delivered to architect specifications on schedule.

about_pullquote: I started because I saw rushed work destroy too many good renovations. We do it right.
about_para_1: Cadby Plastering was established in 2006 by a tradesman frustrated with shortcuts in the industry. Over 18 years, we've built a solid reputation across Birmingham and the Black Country, completing over 1,200 residential and commercial projects. Every job, whether a small repair or a full house replaster, receives the same level of care and attention to detail.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we're reliable, honest, and we finish what we start. We turn up on time, protect your home, and leave surfaces ready for decoration. Word-of-mouth referrals and repeat business make up the majority of our work — the best endorsement any tradesman can ask for.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About Cadby

reviews.text: Had the entire downstairs replastered. Mark and the lads were brilliant — tidy, professional, and they didn't fuss about moving furniture around. Finish is absolutely flawless. Would recommend without hesitation.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Called for a quote on artex removal in our 1970s semi. They came same week, quoted fairly, and the work was done in two days. Looks like a brand new room now. Really pleased with the whole job.
reviews.author: Susan M.

reviews.text: Patched up water damage on our upstairs bedroom after a leak. Very quick turnaround, the plaster's blended perfectly with the existing wall, and the price was honest. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: James L.

address_sub: Serving Birmingham, Solihull, Dudley, and the surrounding West Midlands.
